Package neqsim.process.lng

Class LNGProcessModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.lng.LNGProcessModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class LNGProcessModel extends Object implements Serializable
Runnable LNG process template with consistent process-level performance metrics.

The model wraps a ProcessSystem and the streams and rotating equipment needed to evaluate liquefaction performance. It deliberately keeps thermodynamic and equipment calculations in the standard NeqSim unit operations; this class only coordinates execution and calculates route-comparison metrics on a common basis.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim contributors

    • addEquipment

      public LNGProcessModel addEquipment(ProcessEquipmentInterface equipment)
      Appends downstream equipment to the integrated process system.

      This is useful for product pipelines, storage, loading, boil-off handling, and other equipment that should participate in the same execution and capacity analysis as the LNG train. For upstream integration, use LNGProcessBuilder.setUpstreamProcess(ProcessSystem, StreamInterface). Measurement devices, controllers, and other process elements can be added through getProcessSystem() using the standard NeqSim APIs.

      Parameters:
      equipment - equipment connected to an existing model stream
      Returns:
      this model

    • evaluateCapacity

      public LNGProcessModel.CapacityResult evaluateCapacity()
      Evaluates process-wide equipment and pipeline capacity at the current converged state.

      The result delegates to the universal NeqSim capacity-constraint framework and therefore includes every registered unit with enabled constraints. Call run() first, and configure equipment design limits or apply mechanical-design constraints before using this read-only evaluation.

      Returns:
      ranked capacity result for the complete integrated process

    • autoSizeAndEvaluateCapacity

      public LNGProcessModel.CapacityResult autoSizeAndEvaluateCapacity(double safetyFactor)
      Runs, auto-sizes, activates mechanical-design constraints, reruns, and evaluates capacity.

      The workflow includes upstream equipment supplied through LNGProcessBuilder.setUpstreamProcess(ProcessSystem, StreamInterface) and downstream equipment appended with addEquipment(ProcessEquipmentInterface). Consequently, detailed pipe velocity, pressure-drop, volume-flow, compressor, exchanger, separator, valve, and other available NeqSim constraints are ranked together.

      Parameters:
      safetyFactor - design-capacity multiplier, normally 1.1 to 1.3
      Returns:
      ranked capacity result for the complete integrated process
